accounts.name: poolConfig
docs: Global pool configuration and governance root.

fields.name: authority
docs: The key that may rotate custodians, requesters, and verifying keys.

fields.name: custodianThreshold
docs: Custodian approvals required to execute a disclosure.

fields.name: challengeWindowSecs
docs: Tier-1 challenge window length in seconds.

fields.name: depositLamports
docs: SOL escrowed per deposit.

fields.name: totalDeposits
docs: Lifetime deposit count, for analysis only.

accounts.name: poolVault
docs: The pool's SOL custody. Data-less by design: every lamport in it is
backed by an unspent note commitment in the tree.

accounts.name: merkleTree
docs: Full-node incremental Merkle tree over Poseidon-2 hashes.
Level `ℓ` (0 = leaves) occupies `nodes` at offset
`(1 << (depth+1)) − (1 << (depth+1−ℓ))`, so the root sits in the final
slot. Empty subtrees hold the precomputed zero-hash chain, letting
witnesses cover unwritten leaves.

fields.name: nextLeafIndex
docs: Number of leaves written so far.

fields.name: nodes
docs: Flat 32-byte node store; unwritten slots hold the zero-hash chain.

fields.name: rootsLen
docs: Roots currently in the ring; evictions hold it at capacity.

fields.name: roots
docs: Ring of recent roots, oldest first, zero-padded until full.

accounts.name: nullifierSet
docs: Append-only set of spent nullifiers.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of recorded nullifiers.

fields.name: nullifiers
docs: Flat 32-byte nullifier store.

accounts.name: custodianRegistry
docs: The disclosure committee. A threshold of these keys must approve before
a disclosure may execute, and each approval is a signed transaction.

fields.name: custodians
docs: Committee members as concatenated 32-byte addresses; raw bytes keep
the generated CLI clients renderable. A zero address marks the slot
unset.

accounts.name: requesterRegistry
docs: Entities allowed to file tier-1 and tier-2 disclosure requests.

fields.name: count
docs: Active entries in the parallel arrays below.

fields.name: keys
docs: Requester keys as concatenated 32-byte addresses, parallel to
`max_tiers`.

fields.name: maxTiers
docs: Highest tier each requester may file at.

accounts.name: noteCommitment
docs: Per-note audit record. The envelope and shares are encrypted by the
depositor's client and opaque to the program; the view key is the
per-note consent key that may grant tier-0 requests and file challenges.
Spent notes are *not* marked here: linking a nullifier to its commitment
would break the privacy the pool exists to provide. The nullifier set is
the only spent record.

fields.name: commitment
docs: The commitment; also the PDA seed.

fields.name: viewPubkey
docs: Per-note consent/notification public key.

fields.name: envelopeLen
docs: Active bytes of the encrypted note plaintext, client-opaque.

fields.name: shares
docs: Concatenated per-custodian encrypted key shares, client-opaque.

accounts.name: disclosureRequest
docs: One disclosure request and its state machine.

fields.name: requester
docs: Filing entity.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Client-chosen disambiguator for repeat filings.

fields.name: tier
docs: Tier this request was filed at; see the `TIER_*` constants.

fields.name: commitment
docs: Target note commitment.

fields.name: noticeLen
docs: Active bytes of the encrypted notice to the subject, client-opaque.

fields.name: legalBasisHash
docs: Hash of the legal basis document; required nonzero above tier 0.

fields.name: createdAt
docs: Filing unix timestamp.

fields.name: challengeDeadline
docs: Challenge deadline unix timestamp (tier 1).

fields.name: status
docs: Current status; see the `STATUS_*` constants.

fields.name: granted
docs: Set when the note's view key has granted consent.

fields.name: approvals
docs: Custodian approval bitmask.

accounts.name: disclosureLog
docs: Append-only public record of executed disclosures. The entry is written
by the same instruction that marks the request executed, so execution
without a log record cannot happen.

fields.name: count
docs: Entries written so far.

fields.name: entries
docs: Flat `LOG_ENTRY_BYTES` entries: requester, commitment, tier, nonce,
timestamp, padding.

accounts.name: verifyingKeyAccount
docs: One installed Groth16 verifying key. Slot 0 verifies withdraw proofs
(two public inputs), slot 1 transfer proofs (three).

fields.name: slot
docs: Circuit slot; see the `VK_SLOT_*` constants.

fields.name: alphaG1
docs: αG₁, little-endian affine coordinates.

fields.name: betaG2
docs: βG₂, little-endian affine coordinates.

fields.name: gammaG2
docs: γG₂, little-endian affine coordinates.

fields.name: deltaG2
docs: δG₂, little-endian affine coordinates.

fields.name: icLen
docs: IC entries in use, including the constant term.

fields.name: ic0
docs: IC G₁ points, little-endian; entries beyond `ic_len` are zero.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the successor note's rent. Transfers are anonymous with respect
to the spent note, not to fees: this example has no relayer, so the
submitting wallet signs and pays. Production routes this through a
relayer so even this linkage disappears.
